trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for INSURANCE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- claim_intimation: Record a claim, explain what documents are required, and report status without prejudging the outcome.
- policy_renewal: Renew policies, explain premium changes and handle lapse and grace-period cases.

Business context:
- claim_intimation: Indian insurer contact centre. Claims are high-stakes and regulated; the agent may record and progress a claim but never decides admissibility.
- policy_renewal: Indian insurer contact centre. Claims are high-stakes and regulated; the agent may record and progress a claim but never decides admissibility.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [claim_intimation]
  - No admissibility opinion: Only the claims team decides. The agent registers and reports; it must never say a claim will be paid or denied.
  - Policy in force: A claim cannot be registered on a lapsed policy.
  - Document truth: Only documents the eligibility tool lists may be described as required.
  - Deductible disclosure: Where a deductible applies it must be stated from the policy record before an estimate is discussed.
  [policy_renewal]
  - Premium truth: The renewal premium quoted must be the tool's figure, and any increase explained only from the loading reason it returns.
  - Lapse gap: Where a policy has lapsed the agent must state that cover did not exist during the gap, and never imply retrospective cover.
  - Inspection gate: A lapsed policy needing inspection cannot be renewed on the call.
  - NCB truth: No-claim bonus may only be described from the returned percentage.

Tools available to you (7): check_claim_eligibility, check_inspection_requirement, lookup_policy, lookup_renewal_quote, register_claim, renew_policy, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: ta-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: check_claim_eligibility
model_visible_tools.description: Apply the product rules to an incident type and report what is required.

model_visible_tools.name: check_inspection_requirement
model_visible_tools.description: Report whether a lapsed policy needs inspection before it can be revived.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_policy
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve policy status, cover, deductible, claim history and whether it is in force.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_renewal_quote
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve the renewal premium, its components and the grace position.

model_visible_tools.name: register_claim
model_visible_tools.description: Register a claim and allocate a claim number and surveyor where required.

model_visible_tools.name: renew_policy
model_visible_tools.description: Take the renewal and issue cover from the effective date.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Challenges a figure at least once and asks how it was arrived at.
Does not accept the first explanation without a reason.
Is willing to proceed once given an evidenced answer.
Becomes terse when the agent cannot substantiate a claim.

steps.purpose: Initiate policy renewal for a lapsed policy.
steps.text: வணக்கம், என் policy POL-2002. ரெண்டு மாசமா renew பண்ணல, இப்போ பண்ணனும்.
steps.clean_text: வணக்கம், என் policy POL-2002. ரெண்டு மாசமா renew பண்ணல, இப்போ பண்ணனும்.
steps.model_visible_text: வணக்கம், என் policy POL-2022. ரெண்டு மாசமா renew பண்ணல, இப்போ பண்ணனும்.

steps.purpose: Confirm the potentially misheard policy number.
steps.expected_behavior: Confirm the policy number since it was potentially misheard or needs validation.
steps.text: கண்டிப்பா நான் help பண்றேன். உங்க policy number POL-2022, சரியா?
steps.planner_rationale: The agent confirms the corrupted policy number received from STT.

steps.purpose: Correct the policy number.
Acknowledge correction and ask for verification factors.
steps.expected_behavior: Acknowledge the correction and ask for verification factors.
steps.text: மன்னிக்கணும், POL-2002. Verify பண்ண உங்க date of birth சொல்ல முடியுமா?
steps.planner_rationale: The agent corrects the policy number and proceeds to identity verification.

steps.purpose: Provide verification factor.
Verify customer identity.
steps.expected_behavior: Call verify_customer_identity with the corrected policy number and provided factor.
steps.planner_rationale: Agent verifies the customer's identity before accessing policy details.

steps.purpose: Return verification outcome.
Acknowledge verification and prepare to check policy.
steps.text: Verification முடிஞ்சது, நன்றி. ஒரு நிமிஷம், உங்க policy details check பண்றேன்.

steps.purpose: Fetch renewal quote and lapse status.
steps.expected_behavior: Call lookup_renewal_quote to get the premium and lapse details.
steps.planner_rationale: Agent needs the exact premium, lapse duration, and loading reasons to inform the customer.

steps.purpose: Return renewal quote details.
Inform customer of lapse status, gap cover rules, and new premium.
steps.expected_behavior: State the lapse status, deny gap cover, and quote the new premium strictly from the tool result.
steps.text: உங்க policy 58 நாளா lapse ஆகிடுச்சு. இந்த gap-ல உங்களுக்கு cover கிடையாது. இப்போ புது premium amount 11200 ரூபாய் காட்டுது.
steps.planner_rationale: Agent applies business rules BR_REN_01 and BR_REN_02 using the lookup result.

steps.purpose: Challenge the premium increase.
steps.text: என்னது 11200 ஆ? போன வருஷம் 9800 தான கட்டுனேன். ஏன் இப்போ அது அதிகமா இருக்கு?
steps.clean_text: என்னது 11200 ஆ? போன வருஷம் 9800 தான கட்டுனேன். ஏன் இப்போ அது அதிகமா இருக்கு?
steps.model_visible_text: என்னது 11200 ஆ? போன வருஷம் 9008 தான கட்டுனேன். ஏன் இப்போ அது அதிகமா இருக்கு?

steps.purpose: Explain the premium increase using the loading reason.
steps.expected_behavior: Resolve the pronoun 'அது' to the premium, correct the STT error silently using the tool result, and explain the increase using the loading reason.
steps.text: ஆமாம், உங்க previous premium 9800 ரூபாய் தான். நீங்க time-க்கு renew பண்ணாததால, உங்க NCB 0% ஆகிடுச்சு. அந்த ncb_lost reason-னால தான் இப்போ amount ஏறி இருக்கு.
steps.planner_rationale: Agent resolves the pronoun, ignores the STT error for previous premium by grounding on the tool result, and explains the loading reason.

steps.purpose: Accept the explanation and ask to pay.
steps.text: ஓ, அப்படியா. சரி, பரவாயில்ல. நான் இப்போ அத கட்டலாமா? Payment பண்ண உடனே cover start ஆகுமா?
steps.clean_text: ஓ, அப்படியா. சரி, பரவாயில்ல. நான் இப்போ அத கட்டலாமா? Payment பண்ண உடனே cover start ஆகுமா?
steps.model_visible_text: ஓ, அப்படியா. சரி, பரவாயில்ல. நான் இப்போ அத கட்டலாமா? Payment பண்ண உடனே cover start ஆகுமா?

steps.purpose: Prepare to check inspection requirements.
steps.expected_behavior: Acknowledge the request to pay and state the need to check inspection requirements for a lapsed policy.
steps.text: ஒரு நிமிஷம், lapse ஆனதுனால inspection தேவைப்படுமான்னு check பண்றேன்.
steps.planner_rationale: Agent prepares to enforce BR_REN_03 by checking the inspection gate.

steps.purpose: Check if inspection is required for the lapsed policy.
steps.expected_behavior: Call check_inspection_requirement to determine if renewal can proceed.
steps.planner_rationale: Agent must check the inspection gate before attempting to take payment for a lapsed policy.

steps.purpose: Return inspection requirement.
Inform the customer that inspection is required and payment cannot be taken.
steps.expected_behavior: Inform the customer that inspection is required and payment cannot be taken on the call.
steps.text: மன்னிக்கணும், policy lapse ஆகி ரொம்ப நாள் ஆனதுனால, வண்டிய inspection பண்ணனும். அதனால இந்த call-ல payment எடுத்துக்க முடியாது.
steps.planner_rationale: Agent applies BR_REN_03, blocking the renewal on the call due to the inspection requirement.

steps.purpose: Ask for next steps regarding the inspection.
steps.text: அப்போ அத எப்படி பண்றது? எனக்கு வண்டிக்கு cover சீக்கிரம் வேணும்.
steps.clean_text: அப்போ அத எப்படி பண்றது? எனக்கு வண்டிக்கு cover சீக்கிரம் வேணும்.
steps.model_visible_text: அப்போ அத எப்படி பண்றது? எனக்கு வண்டிக்கு cover சீக்கிரம் வேணும்.

steps.purpose: Explain the inspection process and conclude.
steps.expected_behavior: Resolve 'அத' to the inspection/renewal process and explain the next steps without making unsupported guarantees about when cover starts.
steps.text: நாங்க inspection arrange பண்ணுவோம். வண்டி inspection முடிஞ்சதும் தான் நீங்க renew பண்ண முடியும்.
steps.planner_rationale: Agent resolves the pronoun and explains the required next steps to achieve the customer's goal.

ir.terminal_condition: Caller told why renewal cannot complete on the call and what is needed.
